description: Read a PreCompact capture by ID. Use this to recover context that was lost during mid-session compaction. Three modes control token cost: 'summary' (one paragraph, cheap), 'structured' (decisions/loops/warnings, moderate), 'raw' (full transcript excerpt, expensive — only when summary or structured is insufficient). Workflow: read recovered captures before relying on the latest checkpoint; start with the lightest mode that answers your question.

mode.description: Reading mode. 'summary': one-paragraph overview. 'structured': decisions, open loops, warnings, context shifts. 'raw': full transcript excerpt.

name: read_capture
